transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Thursday, July 30. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. CWG 2026: Dilip Gavit wins Gold, Mohd Basil claims Silver in Men's T47 100m race. Dilip Gavit secured gold in the men's T47 100m race with a new Games Record. Mohammed Basil Morssinganakth followed closely, earning the silver medal for India. This remarkable performance ensured a historic one-two finish for the Indian contingent. England's Kevin Santos claimed the bronze medal in the competitive event. We are in India, be realistic, says HC, lifts curbs on hotel over 2 insects. The Bombay high court quashed a hotel's license suspension after finding minor hygiene issues. A solitary finding of two insects did not justify the continued suspension of the license. The court accepted the hotel's undertaking to maintain high sanitation standards. The Food and Drug Administration's drive aims to improve food safety across Maharashtra. Murali Sreeshankar bags Silver in thrilling long jump final, misses Gold by 6 cm. Murali Sreeshankar secured the silver medal in the men's long jump event. He achieved a best leap of 8.09m in the fiercely contested final. Jamaica's Tajay Gayle won gold with a jump of 8.15m in the fourth round. Scotland's Stephen Mackenzie claimed the bronze medal with a jump of 8.08m. Denied seat, student hacks IIT-Kanpur website to show his 'merit'. A BTech applicant hacked IIT Kanpur's website seeking admission consideration. He claimed he was denied a fair chance in the selection process. The IIT director invited the candidate to campus for an assessment. He stressed that hacking was not the correct approach to gain entry. 'My mornings are for...': Jeff Bezos reveals he never makes any decisions before 10 am. Jeff Bezos prioritizes his mornings, dedicating this time to personal matters and family before diving into work. He strategically avoids challenging tasks until after 10 am, promoting a productive start to his day. He opts for critical conversations mid-morning when his mental clarity is at its peak. Research indicates that decision fatigue can hinder judgment, so Bezos emphasizes making a select number of high-quality decisions each day for maximum effectiveness. Continue with your duties fearlessly, CRPF chief tells troopers amid pellet gun row. CRPF Director General G P Singh supports troops acting in good faith during duty. He assures responsibility for all decisions made in the public interest. An internal probe found standard operating procedures were followed by RAF personnel. Pellet guns were used after other crowd dispersal methods failed. 'Not going to let him get away': Rahul targets Shah over police action on NEET protesters. Rahul Gandhi accused Home Minister Amit Shah of police excesses against protesters. He demanded Shah's dismissal and a Supreme Court-monitored probe into the actions. Gandhi also blamed the RSS for the education sector's current problems. Government ministers challenged Gandhi to provide proof or issue an apology. Ahead of dengue vaccine rollout, all 4 strains found in circulation. India's first dengue virus mapping shows all four serotypes circulating in eight states. This finding could influence the country's upcoming dengue vaccine strategy. Researchers found DENV-2 to be the dominant circulating strain across the nation. Concurrent infections with multiple strains are linked to more severe dengue disease. Guard's accidental gunshot kills man visiting bank in city. A customer was killed Tuesday after a security guard's gun discharged accidentally. Manish Kumar, a farmer, was updating his Aadhaar card at the Union Bank branch. The ex-serviceman guard, Vinod Kumar, was loading cartridges when the firearm discharged. The bullet struck Manish in the back, and he was rushed to the hospital. Barracuda bites Texas girl, 13, but cannot shake her ocean dream. A Texas teenager is recovering after a rare barracuda attack during a family vacation. Claire Macdonel experienced the frightening incident in shallow waters while wearing a shiny bracelet. She is now home and preparing for surgery to repair her hand injury. Despite the painful ordeal, Claire still dreams of becoming a marine biologist. Oregon EMT fired after disabling ambulance cameras, files $800k lawsuit. A former EMT from Oregon has filed a lawsuit against her employer for $800,000, alleging wrongful termination after she disabled covert recording cameras present in ambulances. The company reportedly set up these cameras without informing patients or obtaining their consent. This case raises significant issues regarding patient privacy and the increasing trend of surveillance, particularly given the strict recording regulations in Oregon.

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Farmers' Protest: Demand For 100 percent MSP Moong Procurement Amid Delays And Distress Sales. Thousands of farmers are protesting in Bhopal, alleging delays, e-token hurdles and limited procurement of summer moong at MSP. Meals, Water And Slogans: Farmers Continue Sit-In At Bhopal's RRL Square. Thousands of farmers continued their sit-in at Bhopal's RRL Square on Wednesday, receiving food and water from volunteers while pressing their demands over moong procurement. Narmadapuram Road Protest Triggers Citywide Traffic Chaos In Bhopal. A farmers' protest on Narmadapuram Road caused severe traffic congestion across Bhopal on Wednesday, stranding thousands of commuters for hours. Indore Gets Smart Seed Incubation Centre To Boost Startups And Innovation. The IIM Lucknow Enterprise Incubation Centre and Indore Smart City Development Limited inaugurated the Indore Smart Seed Incubation Centre to strengthen Madhya Pradesh's startup ecosystem. 2,000 MP farmers breach barricades, march to CM's home, Gen Z protesters join in. 'Schools closed, traffic hit': Farmers' protest in Bhopal enters day 2; police tighten security ahead of. Illegal Colony On rupees 40-Crore Government Land Demolished, FIR Against Land Mafia In Indore. The Indore district administration demolished an illegal colony allegedly developed on government land worth rupees 40 crore in Sirpur and registered an FIR against the accused land mafia. Madhya Pradesh Deploys AI, Strengthens Tiger Protection Force As Big Cat Population Surges. Why thousands of farmers are protesting in Bhopal with Hanuman Chalisa recitations and the Tricolour. MP Moong farmers' stir likely to end soon as govt announces procuring 60 percent of produce at MSP. Rejected Marriage Proposal Led To Bank Employee's Murder In Indore. A 35-year-old man from Gwalior has been arrested for allegedly strangling a bank employee to death at her rented house in Indore's Khajrana area and setting her body on fire to stage a suicide. MP: Ministers meet farmers' delegation amid moong procurement protest in Bhopal. Madhya Pradesh CM Mohan Yadav inaugurates Nishatpura Railway Station in Bhopal. Demands not met: Farmers scuffle with cops after talks with Madhya Pradesh govt. 13 years after oxytocin order, HC seeks MP govt's compliance report. Madhya Pradesh Government Sets Up Ministerial Committee To Hold Talks With Protesting Farmers. Hit-and-run near Bhopal leaves 20-yr-old dead, bro injured. Bhojshala complex case: Don't succumb to bullying, Muslim side tells Madhya Pradesh government in SC.

transcript.title: Business and markets
transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. US Fed leaves federal funds rate unchanged: How can a status quo impact the Indian stock market?. The US Federal Reserve kept rates unchanged on 29 July. While the decision may ease foreign capital outflows and strengthen the rupee, looming inflation risks and geopolitical tensions remain significant concerns for investors. Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold and silver recover as Fed keeps rates unchanged, dollar weakens. Gold and silver prices rose over 1 percent after the U.S. Federal Reserve kept interest rates steady, lowering the dollar and Treasury yields. Gold futures surged to an intraday high of $4,115, while silver reached $59.40. Geopolitical tensions also influenced market movements. US stocks stay lower after Fed leaves rates unchanged. GLOBAL-MARKETS/ (WRAPUP 7, PIX):GLOBAL MARKETS US Federal Reserve holds rates steady for fifth consecutive meeting: 5 key takeaways. The U.S. Federal Reserve, led by Chair Kevin Warsh, kept interest rates unchanged for the fifth consecutive meeting, awaiting clearer inflation and economic trends before modifying monetary policy, following a two-day FOMC meeting. Juniper Green Energy raises rupees 539 crore from anchor investors ahead of IPO opening on Thursday. Juniper Green Energy has raised rupees 539.4 crore from anchor investors for its IPO on July 30, 2026. The company allocated shares at rupees 225 each, with significant participation from domestic mutual funds. The IPO aims to fund projects and support India's clean energy transition. Microsoft stock edges higher ahead of Q4 results, Wall Street eyes AI payoff. According to consensus estimates, analysts expect Microsoft to report adjusted earnings of $4.24 per share on revenue of $87.62 billion Cupid makes additional $5 million investment in GII Healthcare platform. Cupid has invested an additional $5 million in GII Healthcare Investment Limited, reinforcing its belief in the healthcare sector's growth. The investment, made entirely from internal funds, enhances Cupid's commitment to GII's long-term strategy without disclosing its stake size. Oil prices rebound, jump 8 percent as Trump warns Iran after attacks on US forces; Brent nears $90. Crude oil prices surged on 29 July after Trump warned of consequences for Iran following attacks on US forces. Brent crude increased 7.5 percent to $84.58, while WTI rose 6.3 percent to $85.53. Renewed hostilities raised supply disruption fears amid fragile ceasefire hopes. PNGRB plans to open city gas for external investors. The PNGRB plans to allow third-party capital investment in city gas distribution areas. Oil prices surge 6 percent amid fresh escalation in West Asia. Rising crude prices are a concern for India, which imports nearly 90 percent of its oil requirements. A sustained $1 per barrel increase in crude prices over a year could add rupees 18,000 crore to India's import bill. GAIL, RCF ink pact for gas-based fertiliser plant. GAIL and Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers have signed an agreement for a joint venture. Nvidia's $750 billion circular financing loop: How it became banker, supplier and investor , and how big is the risk?. Nvidia is pursuing AI deals worth more than $750 billion, raising concerns about circular financing that could artificially inflate chip demand. Anti-paper leak amendment Bill: 8 things to know. The Lok Sabha approved the Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026. Indo-MIM IPO versus Xtranet Technologies IPO versus Lohia Corp IPO: What GMP signals about the listing gain?. The IPOs of Xtranet Technologies, Indo-MIM, and Lohia Corp saw strong investor demand. Indo-MIM's grey market premium at rupees 180 per share suggests a potential 37 percent listing gain, while Xtranet and Lohia indicate lower premiums of 10.6 percent and 4.47 percent , respectively. Fertiliser industry seeks hike in subsidy rate. The Fertiliser Association of India seeks higher subsidy rates for the upcoming Kharif season. US stocks slide as oil surges and markets await Fed rate decision. As of 10:30 a.m. Eastern Time, the S and P 500 sank 0.7 percent . The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 1.4 percent , and the Nasdaq Composite was 1 percent lower Students can change govt, says CJP's Dipke. Abhijeet Dipke warns the government against harassing students protesting the NEET exam leak. Manipal Health Enterprises IPO off to slow start, subscribed 15 percent on opening day; retail portion booked 27 percent. Manipal Health Enterprises' IPO saw a sluggish start, being subscribed 0.15 times on Day 1, with retail and non-institutional portions lagging. The company raised rupees 4,167 crore from anchor investors. The total issue size is rupees 9,275 crore, with shares listing on August 5. Energy drink crackdown has distributors worried. Distributors are refusing to pick up existing energy drink stocks nationwide. US stock market today: Wall Street futures inch higher ahead of Fed decision; Middle East tensions resurface. US stock futures showed modest gains amid cautious investor sentiment ahead of the Federal Reserve's policy decision. S and P 500 and Nasdaq futures rose 0.2 percent , while Dow futures fell. Nothing less than Rahul Gandhi's apology: BJP. The BJP strongly refuted Rahul Gandhi's claims about the firing on protesting students. US Treasury yields rise as markets await Fed rate decision. US Treasury yields ended a three-day decline amidst anticipation of the Federal Reserve's rate decision. Despite falling from July highs, yields are poised for significant monthly increases amid growing inflation concerns driven by higher oil prices. Bharat atta, rice set for market return. The government plans to resume selling subsidized Bharat Atta and Bharat Rice soon. FED Meeting Highlights: Fed holds rates steady at 3.5 percent -3.75 percent , Warsh says, 'goal is to keep inflation manageable'. FED Meeting Highlights: The Federal Reserve left its key interest rate unchanged Wednesday. The Dow traded 744 points lower, or 1.4 percent , while the S and P 500 slid 0.3 percent . Coal India to fire up capex with rupees 68,000 cr spend. Coal India plans a significant capital expenditure of rupees 68,000 crore over four fiscal years. SBI raises rupees 4,691 crore through the issuance of tier-1 bonds. Details here. State Bank of India raised rupees 4,691 crore through its first Basel III-compliant AT1 bond issuance, driven by strong institutional demand. The bonds have a 7.75 percent coupon rate and a perpetual tenor, with an AA+ rating from CRISIL and CARE Ratings. Transfer of unclaimed shares may go digital. The government plans a new digital system for unclaimed shares and dividends.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Bank holidays in August 2026: Independence Day, Onam, Raksha Bandhan and other holidays; check complete list. Bank holidays: Bank branches will observe numerous closures throughout August 2026 due to holidays. Independence Day on August 15 will cause nationwide bank shutdowns. Several state-specific festivals like Ker Puja and Tendong Lho Rum Faat will also affect branch operations. ITR filing 2026: Why 31 July is not the deadline for all salaried taxpayers and who gets more time. The 31 July ITR filing deadline may not apply to all salaried taxpayers. The applicable due date depends on the taxpayer's overall income profile, ITR form, and audit requirements. Those with business or professional income may get additional time. ITR filing mistakes to avoid before July 31 deadline: Expert reveals 5 mistakes that can lead to delays, failure of ITR form submission. ITR filing : Taxpayers rush to file income tax returns before the July 31 deadline. Common errors include not e-verifying and mismatched personal details. Reconciling income with Form 16 and AIS is crucial for successful submission. Large and mid-cap funds strike a balance: Higher returns than large-caps, lower volatility than mid-caps. Large and mid-cap funds have historically delivered a balance between returns and volatility. Over the past 5 years, the benchmark index gave 14 percent returns, compared with 10 percent for large-caps and 18 percent for mid-caps. PNB Housing Finance tops list of mutual funds' 10 favourite small-cap stocks; Crompton Greaves, Delhivery make the cut. Despite varying investment strategies, some small-cap stocks are common across mutual fund portfolios. The latest analysis reveals the 10 most widely held small-cap stocks, with PNB Housing Finance featuring in 146 schemes, followed by Crompton Greaves and RBL Bank. 8th Pay Commission: How 6 percent annual increment may add rupees 20 lakh to Level 8 employees' basic pay in 10 years. 8th Pay Commission salary calculator: Employee groups are advocating for a higher annual salary increment in the upcoming 8th Pay Commission. They suggest increasing the current three percent rate to at least five percent annually. This change aims to substantially boost the basic pay of central government employees. Calculations show a six percent increment could add millions over ten years. Filed ITR in May or June? Here's why you should revisit it and check these 7 key things before 31 July deadline. Taxpayers who filed their ITR in May or June should revisit their return before the 31 July deadline. Checking e-verification status, AIS, TIS, Form 26AS, TDS credits, bank details and reported income can help avoid errors and refund delays. What is crypto staking and how does it work? A practical guide for beginners. Crypto staking allows holders to support blockchain networks and earn rewards. Validators are chosen based on committed tokens, reducing reliance on mining. Users can delegate tokens or use exchange services for easier participation. Staking rewards vary due to on-chain conditions and network economics. ITR filed and verified? Here's how the Income Tax Department spots mismatches, and when it sends a notice. The CPC first verifies that you've used the correct ITR form, filled in all mandatory schedules, and that there are no calculation errors. If it finds major issues, you may receive a defective return notice. Gratuity forfeited, pension denied, and leave encashment delayed for 9 years due to criminal proceedings leading to employee's conviction; family fought back in Delhi High Court and won 6 percent interest on leave encashment on this ground. Gratuity, pension forfeited but only leave encashment paid after nine years delay without interest; retired employee wins case in Delhi High Court as court directs employer to pay 6 percent interest on leave encashment. Know how this employee's family won case in Delhi High Court. Hidden risks of UPI Autopay: Nykaa AVP's LinkedIn post sparks debate about free trials. Lokesh Ahuja from Nykaa shared a cautionary tale about hidden AutoPay mandates after teaching his mother how to make UPI payments. He emphasises the importance of digital literacy. TDS deducted but you haven't filed your ITR yet? Here's what happens if you miss the July 31 deadline. Failing to file your income tax return by July 31, 2026, after TDS deduction has consequences. You will face interest charges and a late filing fee for delayed submissions. Not filing an ITR prevents claiming refunds and carrying forward losses. Virtual digital asset income is taxed regardless of the exemption limit. Tax consultant made error in ITR filing: ITAT Chennai gives relief to taxpayer, waives rupees 1.92 lakh penalty. A Chennai taxpayer faced a rupees 1.92 lakh penalty after her tax consultant made errors in the ITR filing. ITAT Chennai waived the penalty, ruling that a genuine mistake by a tax professional cannot be treated as misreporting of income under Section 270A. Would your family know how to access your wealth in an emergency?. A single, regularly updated financial master sheet can organize scattered accounts, key legal documents, and vital contacts before a crisis hits. SIP reduces only entry-timing risk: Here's why valuation, liquidity and portfolio concentration still need attention. SIPs help reduce entry-timing risk through rupee-cost averaging but cannot shield investors from valuation, liquidity, concentration or fund-selection risks. Investors should not mistake SIPs for a complete risk-management strategy. Is government planning to scrap Long Term Capital Gain (LTCG) tax on equities for domestic investors in FY 26-27? Minister responds. Long Term Capital Gain: The Finance Ministry has denied contemplating the scrapping of LTCG tax on equities for domestic investors. There is no current proposal under consideration to remove this tax for retail investors. ITR filing deadline: After 4 extensions in last 5 years, why AY 2026-27 may not get extra time. As the 31 July deadline for filing ITR approaches, taxpayers hope for an extension like in previous years. Here's why AY 2026-27 is different for tax filing. How to pick the right ITR form – Here's the guide. The ITR filing deadline for Assessment Year 2026-27 is almost here. ITR filing 2026: Expecting an income tax refund? Check these 5 details before filing your return to avoid delays. Expecting an income tax refund this year? Filing your ITR is only half the job. Simple mistakes like an unvalidated bank account, TDS mismatch or pending tax demand can delay your refund even after the return is processed. 5 credit cards with complimentary airport lounge access without any minimum spend criteria in 2026: One of them is lifetime free. Looking for credit cards with free airport lounge access? Check these 5 credit cards that still offer complimentary domestic or international lounge access without any minimum spending criteria. These cards also have a low joining fee and one of them is free for lifetime. Check other things like eligibility criteria, rewards, benefits etc. FD rates in July 2026: Small finance banks offer up to 8.10 percent ; compare returns from 7 leading lenders. July 2026 FD rates show small finance banks offering up to 8.10 percent interest, ahead of leading private and public sector banks. Compare FD rates, tenures and key investment factors across seven major lenders before booking a fixed deposit to secure better returns. Are you an NRI who sold an under-construction property? Here's what actually counts as your "Date of Purchase" for capital gains calculation. NRIs selling under-construction property must use the allotment date for capital gains. This date determines long-term versus short-term capital gains tax treatment. The Bombay High Court and other rulings support the allotment date as the acquisition point. This principle applies even when possession or registration occurs much later. ITR filing deadline 2026: Experts explain 5 reasons you shouldn't wait until July 31 to file your income tax return. With the July 31 ITR filing deadline nearing, experts warn that waiting until the last day could cost taxpayers far more than just a late filing fee. From losing tax benefits to delayed refunds and portal glitches, here's why filing early is the smarter choice.
